THE SAMPLE CITATION ACT, 2017

1. Short title.— This Act may be called the Sample Citation Act, 2017.

2. Substitution in the principal Act.— In the said Act the following words shall be substituted.

3. Savings.— The earlier notification ceases to have effect from the appointed day under this Act.
